Icon-only interactive element that triggers a user action via click, tap, or keyboard activation, for actions where a single icon communicates the action clearly enough that a text label isn't needed — e.g. toolbar controls, dismiss/close, or repeated inline actions in dense UI.

## Variants

**primary** — the brand-coloured, highest-emphasis icon action; solid treatment for a standalone or prominent icon-only control, one per view.

**secondary** — assertive neutral icon action not tied to the brand colour; solid dark treatment for a prominent icon-only control that isn't the primary action.

**tertiary** — lowest-emphasis icon action; outlined treatment for toolbar clusters and repeated inline icon actions.
